# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    شَرْط ←→ שָׁרְט                    ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / stipulation           ║
║    root: ש-ר-ט / ش-ر-ط               ║
║                                      ║
║    to cut, to incise                 ║
║    to make conditional               ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

the line drawn before agreement

```
     ┌─────────────────┐
     │  IF    →  THEN  │
     │  אִם    →  אָז   │
     │  إن    →   فـ   │
     └─────────────────┘
```

we meet at the scratch
the mark in the clay
where terms are inscribed

شَرْط = שָׁרְט

cognate mirrors
same mouth
same knife
same contract

```
│
├── what is your condition?
│   מה השרט שלך؟
│   ما شرطك؟
│
└── the scratch that binds
```
